crime: For months, one girl sat beside {WITCH_NAME} despite her harsh words, left little gifts by her plate, and insisted she was kind underneath. Sometimes {WITCH_NAME} wanted that girl to be afraid of her, and hated herself for wanting it.
At supper the girl took her hand before everyone. “See? Nothing happens.” {WITCH_NAME} held down the heat rising with her anger.

Days later, while the others were showering, the girl found her alone in the recreation room and opened her arms. {WITCH_NAME} returned the embrace, heated her skin, and held the girl against the floor until she was dead.

A prisoner coming back from the showers found the body. Only the floor beneath it was scorched. The burns were deepest on the palms and inner arms, leaving the outer arms untouched. The heat had come from the person the girl was holding: {WITCH_NAME}.
fields.epitaph: The girl finally held her, and found only fire.
fields.epithet: The Fire Afraid of Its Own Warmth
execution: A stake stood in a bed of oil-soaked wood. She was bound to it with iron thorns around her waist. The band tightened, and pain and anger drove up her skin's heat until the wood caught fire. The flames burned around her until nothing remained.

magic.name: Thornfire
magic.text: She can make her skin hot enough to burn anything that touches it.
